integrity: Exhaustive finite computations were run on the included standalone verifier for widths three through ten; the infinite statement has a mathematical proof and has not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted zero-field binary spins; exact one-spin transitions only. Lower levels classified for all widths, with connectivity threshold between odd-width ground states; no assertion that all odd states at threshold five form a single component. Existing even-width ground degeneracy and width-five layout are acknowledged.
title: Low-energy single-spin geometry of antiferromagnetic Möbius ladders
